dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Both repeatable flags are registered; validation rejects mixed selections and formatted output; the added help example repeats --field. The no-selection path preserves the baseline output path.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go listOpts, flags, validateListOpts, and Example hunk

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Name resolution uses EqualFold and canonical returned names; missing names/IDs enumerate sorted candidates; ambiguous IDs are now sorted deterministically.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The initial item query already fetches 100 field definitions. Selected fields invoke pagination only when Fields.PageInfo has another page, append every page, and return errors before rendering.
evidence: product.diff: queries.go ProjectItemFields and item_list.go resolveFields

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and multi-value variants are rendered, with ID extraction, empty unknown values, compact numbers, and CR/LF normalization.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go formatFieldValue, projectItemFieldValues, and normalizeCell

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Resolved canonical headers are appended in request order; each row looks up rendered values by field node ID, emitting an empty cell for missing values. The baseline owner/project/items path remains intact.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go runList, printResults, and projectItemFieldValues

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Validation and resolution errors return before exporter/table output; pagination errors propagate. The focused changes reuse existing query types and add targeted tests without altering unrelated behavior.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go validateListOpts, resolveFields, and runList
